text.en: Dog owners frequently emphasize how gently the groomers accommodate pets with specific physical or emotional needs. Clients with deaf, blind, and elderly dogs note that the team remains remarkably patient, while pets suffering from separation anxiety settle in calmly throughout their grooming visits.

The salon personnel receive steady praise from long-term and visiting clients on Highgate High Street. Reviewers highlight Rita and her team for going the extra mile to support anxious dogs and their owners, offering warm reassurance and maintaining friendly communication at every appointment.

Clients are delighted with the finished styling and thorough coat care provided at the salon. Reviewers mention that their dogs return home with immaculate cuts, healthy skin treatments, and beautifully trimmed fur, matching the exact styling preferences requested before the groom.

q.en: Does Hair of the Dog groom older or nervous dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently praise the groomers for their patience and gentle care with elderly, anxious, blind, or deaf dogs.

q.en: Where is the grooming parlour located?

a.en: The salon is situated on Highgate High Street in North London, featuring an adjacent pet boutique with canine supplies.
Services include full body styling, baths with blow-dries, undercoat de-shedding, and introductory appointments for puppies.
